info.name: BookSphere - Notification Service
info.description:
Postman collection for Notification Service (BS-BE-08).

Recommended run order:
1. 00 - Auth Setup
2. 01 - Internal Notification API - Direct Service
3. 02 - My Notifications - Via Gateway
4. 03 - Search All Notifications - Via Gateway
5. 04 - Detail & Mark Read - Via Gateway
6. 05 - Notification API - Direct Service
7. 06 - Gateway Security

Prerequisites: Auth, Notification, Gateway, Discovery running.
Seed data: notification id=1 (user 3), id=2 (user 4), id=3 (user 3).
Note: Mark-read tests may change is_read state; reset DBNotification to rerun folder 04.
